cohort: The study included placenta samples from six pregnant women, comprising three healthy controls and three diagnosed with pre-eclampsia.
finding: The study identified 1,891 dysregulated genes in pre-eclampsia placentas, with specific downregulation of TEK, CSF1, IGF1, and ANGPT2 proposed to contribute to pre-eclampsia pathogenesis by inhibiting trophoblast proliferation and affecting spiral artery remodeling.
cross-section timing: Placenta samples were collected from pregnant women, implying at the time of delivery or termination.
gest_age: Gestational weeks were 39.33 +/- 1.03 in the control group and 35.76 +/- 2.41 in the pre-eclampsia group.
